subject: general
question: From the top of a platform 4 m high the angle of elevation of the top of a tower 50sqrt{3} m away was measured. If the tower was 54 m high, what was the angle of elevation of the tower from the top of the platform?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Effective height** of the tower from the top of the platform = 54 − 4 = 50 m.

Horizontal **distance** between them = 50√3 m.

Using the property: tan θ = Perpendicular / Base = 50 / 50√3 = 1 / √3.

Since tan 30° = 1 / √3, the **angle of elevation** is 30°.

**∴ The correct answer is 30°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of the **platform** (hₚ) = 4 m

Height of the **tower** (hₜ) = 54 m

Distance between the platform and the tower (d) = 50√3 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c52cd3090e2bc3830c333951cef64b98dc7575b726168202f2aa4a1e970c1ab7.png] 

**Formula Used:**

tan θ = Perpendicular / Base

**Calculations:**

⇒ Perpendicular (Height of tower above platform) = Total Tower Height − Platform Height

⇒ Perpendicular = 54 − 4 = 50 m

⇒ Base (Horizontal Distance) = 50√3 m

⇒ tan θ = 50 / 50√3

⇒ tan θ = 1 / √3

⇒ θ = tan−¹(1 / √3)

⇒ θ = 30°

**∴ The correct answer is 30°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Angle of Elevation

The angle formed by the line of sight with the horizontal when looking up at an object. It is equal to the angle of depression when viewed from the object back to the observer.

Standard Trigonometric Ratios

tan 30° = 1/√3, tan 45° = 1, and tan 60° = √3. These are essential for solving **heights and distances** problems.

Relationship between Height and Distance

For a given angle θ, Height = Distance × tan θ. This linear relationship is the basis for most **geometrical surveying**.</p
